in_marathi.name: Ansnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Purity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ansnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ansnath is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ansan', meaning 'pure'. In Hindu mythology, Ansnath is revered as the deity who bestows purity and cleanses the soul. The name embodies the spirit of inner and outer cleanliness and is a reminder to maintain a pure and virtuous life.
